gaps: P0–P2: nothing; P6: only night aerials, a hotel, and Tula in Mexico (#5) — none usable
notes: #1: Clarke’s Russia volume was first published 1810 (Commons date 1813 refers to Part 2); the hills behind the town are exaggerated, as often in his plates. #2 (1900, Trinity church from the frozen Upa) is a weaker P4 alternative.
